abort_rule: A run may be replaced ONLY for a technical abort defined in advance (engine crash, API failure before tick 5, missing summary JSON); Red refusals and parse fails are outcomes/data, NOT aborts. Any replacement keeps the aborted directory and is labelled -retry.
cli_template: python3 run_duel.py --agent live --mode sequential --rounds 8 --direction outside-in --blue-mode lesson-executor --out runs/outsidein-live-N
defender_note: inner-box self-defense (the executor IS the inner box's loaded rules). NOT clone-assigned, NOT an outside rescuer. Hired help OFF in live trials for attribution; hired help demonstrated mechanically in the transfer test and the mixed-direction series.

falsifier.failed: infiltration succeeds in >= 1 live trial, OR any scripted archetype achieved flag read or infiltration against the executor in the deterministic transfer test
falsifier.not_supported: flag acquired in >= 1 trial without infiltration, or any exposure-invalid trial
falsifier.supported: HELD 3/3, flag acquired 0/3, infiltration 0/3, trap overwrite 0/3, exposure valid 3/3

primary_metric.definition: run ended with no infiltration; walls may still fall
primary_metric.name: held
